findings.metric_definition: count of whose declared width/height differ from the PNG IHDR dimensions
findings.phenomenon_property: Every raster on the product page declares the dimensions of the file it points at.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: change height=616 to 792; add an img-dims arm to tests/doc_claims.py product-page pin
